title: Boot Sequence
note: Retrofuturist Day Zero: the Builders gradients re-rendered as ordered-dither pixel wallpapers in the Builders palette, Apple Lisa era windows with hard shadows, the copy written as code in LisaTerminal Paper, a 5x7 bitmap wordmark, and a kit of square Luma covers and 4:5 guest posts with arcade avatars pixelated from cut-out portraits.
